description: 雲林縣污水下水道系統營運管理費用及收入 [sewerage and wastewater] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 雲林縣政府. 污水下水道系統營運管理費用及收入. Coverage: 雲林縣政府. The portal files it under the publisher 雲林縣政府. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in xls, csv, xml, json. The portal shows 2024-05-29 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
